method: Independent mathematical and native source-order review, followed by a separate execution of the finite controls.
mathematical_checks: The root tuple is designated before its first private hash at every protected alias; traffic material and direction are designated before the first block allocation.

The marked index is selected before its first private computation across both endpoints, including skipped receive steps and failed authentication. Complete material identity, direction and original index determine cache equality.
Additional disclosures consist of pre-Mark earlier message keys and the marked pair successor. Complete session captures retain the original acquisition predicate and original saved-version times.
The original accepted logical send identifies the challenge and final selector. A missing mark or accepted send makes valid-target false.

Persisting the original SendPlan precedes the first chain step and encryption. Resume preserves its message identifier, plaintext and associated data; later persistence failure does not create a new encryption tuple.
Candidate-local free stops retain their original time certificate. Original-game score and Boolean localization precede candidate-specific comparisons, so the attribution residual is charged once.
Record, component, complete-tuple and root-entry score/event coefficients match the existing local accounting. Delta_prefix includes the traffic-prefix comparison and does not repeat Delta_init.
The chain comparison introduces no additional message-index guessing factor. Whole-execution primitive budgets can grow with the fixed lifetime L.

A successful fresh decryption before the at-most-one honest encryption remains a historical integrity witness; a later encryption does not erase the recorded event. The final qualified native event is a subset of this witness event.
The expanded continuation preserves executed-slot association through traffic installation and earlier-key disclosures, with its whole-execution signing resources.
review_corrections_completed: Specified all-alias first-private-hash and first-block allocation boundaries.
Qualified earlier-key projections as pre-Mark and distinguished index-wise chain cost from other lifetime-dependent budgets.
Fixed the finite checker to predesignate material and direction before each trace, reject nonmatching marks and retain nonselected computations.
Reported the three reachable send persistence paths without duplicating the unreachable second-write branch.
State the observable free-stop certificate using an acquired intact version and its original save time relative to a candidate reservation, before the final compromise cut is selected.
interpretation: The source-order and finite controls support the stated correspondence obligations; the security reduction is the written mathematical argument under the manuscript interfaces and primitive assumptions.
